text:
sahil: starting the scheduled spot/preemptible game-day in us-west1 now. plan: force evictions in the spot pool (mixed-capacity) to validate graceful fallback to reserved and degraded modes. window 10–30m. :rotating_light:
linh: outlined runbook in thread. brief checklist: 1) notify traffic router, 2) throttle noncritical batches, 3) enable small-cache warming on reserved pool, 4) collect p95/p99 for token latency and queue length.
casey: pushed canary config to routing: fallback_policy=prefer-dedicated, degrade_quality=low for non-prod keys. watching metrics.
ops-bot: TEST EVENT: will trigger eviction on nodes with label pool=spot-gpu in 60s. command: `kubectl label node spot-* chaos=evict --overwrite` then cordon/drain.
sahil: reminder: do not evict nodes with taint=keep-for-rolling. we need at least 10% spot to remain for interruption distribution tests.
jordan: snapshotting dashboards: 1) redis queue length, 2) inference-p95, 3) model-kv-cache hit, 4) node-utilization.
ops-bot: EVICTION START: cordon node spot-gpu-7; drain job started. logs:
```
I090 12:07:15 Evicting pod infer/llm-worker-43
I090 12:07:18 Drained 1 pods, 2 remain
```
casey: saw a transient increase in queue time + about 12% more requests routed to dedicated pool. routing fallback worked.
meera: alerting noticed container restarts on reserved-nodes due to memory pressure when many pods moved over. increasing reserved autoscale by +2 nodes.
linh: recorded failures: 7 requests timed out (upstream model hung) — investigating whether timeout thresholds need adjusting during mass reschedules.
sahil: key success criteria: a) no more than 5% error rate delta vs baseline, b) p95 latency < baseline + 2s, c) all evicted pods rescheduled or properly failed over within 5 minutes. current status: error delta ~0.8%, p95 +1.3s, reschedule median 2m45s. so far within SLO.
jordan: cost note: spot pool saved ~28% last month but we need better prewarming to avoid CPU spin-ups during failover. add warm-start caching in Optimize playbook.
casey: postmortem checklist: capture pod eviction traces, node-level oom/kubelet logs, and routing decisions. I'll export traces to /ops/game-days/2025-11-spot-evict/trace-1753509123.json.
ops-bot: EVICTION PHASE 2: forced delete pod infer/llm-worker-51 on spot-gpu-12 (simulate mid-request preempt).
meera: this caused a 0.2% increase in user-facing 5xx errors; majority retried successfully via client-side retries. we should test shorter client retry intervals next run.
linh: action: add a small grace window to load balancer healthcheck (30s -> 45s) to avoid flapping during reschedule spikes. assigning @jordan.
jordan: on it. will coordinate with networking to add a temporary route for warm-cache priming traffic.
sahil: wrap-up: overall behavior acceptable, routing fallback worked, reserved autoscale handled surge but we saw memory pressure. ops items: - add warm cache step in Dedicated autoscale, - reduce heavy batch window during expected evictions, - add client-retry guidance to SDK docs.
casey: creating follow-ups in backlog: INFRA-879 (warm cache), INFRA-880 (LB healthcheck tweak), INFRA-881 (SDK retry defaults). tagging for Q/A and perf.
meera: will open contrib PR to observability repo to add eviction labels to inference traces.
linh: summary file attached to thread (link): https://internal.redwood/intra/game-days/1753509123/report.md
sahil: thanks everyone. closing the window. will schedule a short retro tomorrow to confirm postmortem notes and owners. :thumbsup:
